name: JSON Grid
description: Explore and edit JSON as nested grids, DevTools-style trees and source. Copy JSONPath, search, filter and format locally.
releaseNotes: Align source fold chevrons with line numbers. Simplify object tables to key/value rows, use one-based row numbers for arrays, share header and row-number colors, and remove table caption and summary rows.

zh-CN.description: 将 JSON 转为可编辑嵌套网格与 DevTools 风格树形，支持路径复制、搜索筛选、格式化和撤销；数据在本地处理。
